evidence_status: User-reported physical-device failure; cause unresolved. Not an independent semantic or usability validation.
first_software_defect: The loader discarded stage/runtime detail and the initializing engine reference, exposed only error.message, and presented an unloaded general AI as clarification needed.
repairs: Separate download progress, initialization, readiness and general-chat availability.
Capture bounded local stage, browser/preflight GPU, runtime logger, error/stack/cause and cleanup evidence.
Retain engine instance for bounded unload attempt; require explicit page reload before initialization retry.
Export a model-only report without source questions; retain it in the broader tab trace.
Preserve source rules, corpus/profile control, model/runtime pins and cache identity.
boundaries: Initialization is ready only when reload resolves; 100% callback is insufficient.
GPU/cause diagnosis is not inferred from exit(1). Available logs can be incomplete and are explicitly bounded.
No model-weight download, training, paid fallback, cache/ledger deletion or real iPad repair is claimed by authored tests.
cases_role: Authored development tests. GPU/runtime failure cases are simulated; actual pinned WebLLM constructor/logger/unload is also checked without weights.
